scope: Five independent instrumented pairs; main-thread exclusive decomposition. Worker spans overlap and are never summed into model time. SDK wrapper spans include conversion and waiting, not pure device time.

execution.rule: All primary current/incremental/runtime gates; require at least2% median gain over wide to add a scan variant. No samples discarded.
execution.scope: Frozen B1/T615 logits only for FP32/precise615/readout; original qualified paths for other shapes, short multi-batch precision repair retained.
execution.mlp_rule: Require at least2% full-model median improvement in final combined path to retain new640 graphs; otherwise original dual-handle128+128+384.
execution.domain_rule: All13 original-current gates plus12 rotating samples/mode. Require2% median gain to add readout/domain restriction. Final34-case regression mandatory.
